t: The Hillbrush Dustpan and Soft Banister Set is engineered for efficient debris removal. This blue dustpan and brush is ideal for quick clean-ups in workshops, construction sites, and domestic environments, ensuring work areas remain tidy. Constructed from durable polypropylene with soft polyester bristles, it effectively sweeps dust, dirt, and light debris from floors and workbenches. Its compact, nesting design allows for convenient storage, making it a practical tool for maintaining cleanliness across various professional and home settings, including garages and utility rooms.
